activity.role: Exiled Islamic jurist and scholar released from confinement in Marrakesh
activity.notes: The TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi dates Ahmad Baba's conditional release on 19 May 1596; he was not allowed to leave Marrakesh, continuing scholarly and juridical teaching there. This records a person-specific transition during Moroccan Saadi captivity, NOT service as a Saadi officer, not a politically voluntary allegiance, and not a rule over Timbuktu. Oxford Research Encyclopedia places exile c.1594–1608, providing the distinct historical context. Different publications disagree on the first 1593/1594 transport date; no forced exact 1593 move is asserted.
